method.formula: 0.5 × highest associated law index /12 ×100 + 0.5 × case fit index
method.overrides: Verified urgent needs come first. A current fit No caps non-urgent priority at 39; no automatic closure.
method.uncertainty: Missing scores contribute a range; ranges crossing a band require an evidence check.
method.validation: Provisional demo review index, not misuse probability, established legal abuse or official intake policy.

coverage: Combined arithmetic, bands and unknown-score ranges
Atomic saves, revision conflicts and rollback of both tasks
Edits, idempotence, one-answer updates and clearing
Sandbox isolation, synthetic PDF marker, export flags and reset

limitations: Equal weights and thresholds are provisional demo assumptions, not calibrated probabilities or official intake policy.
Law associations and current support needs need independent verification.
The feedback reranker captures separate unadjudicated labels; it does not train a neural model.
Synthetic examples and their exports are excluded from real collection and training.
